q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-13. Q2 FY2027 earnings would typically be released in late May or early June 2027 (following the standard May earnings cycle shown in the research). This gives approximately **9-10 months** until resolution.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provides NVIDIA's explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**.

This means the company's official guidance range is:
- Low end: $91.0B × 0.98 = **$89.18 billion**
- High end: $91.0B × 1.02 = **$92.82 billion**
- Midpoint: **$91.0 billion**

NVIDIA's guidance is typically quite accurate since:
1. The company has excellent visibility into its data center demand (the bulk of revenue)
2. NVIDIA maintains conservative guidance practices
3. The ±2% margin is their standard confidence band
4. The research explicitly states this guidance was provided on May 20, 2026 as part of Q1 FY2027 earnings

The question asks what the forward guidance *will be*, which according to the research has already been announced as $91.0B ± 2%. Since we're asked for the point estimate of guidance (not actual results), the answer should center on this midpoint.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Significant deterioration in AI demand or capex spending
- Major geopolitical disruptions beyond the already-excluded China revenue
- Unexpected competitive pressure or market share loss
- Recession impacting enterprise capex budgets
- Supply chain disruptions affecting product availability

However, NVIDIA typically guides conservatively, so actual outperformance is more common than underperformance.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Stronger-than-expected AI capex acceleration (particularly hyperscalers)
- Resolution of China export restrictions (though guidance excludes this)
- Market share gains from competitors
- New product launches or refresh cycles driving incremental demand
- Broader enterprise adoption of AI accelerators beyond hyperscalers

NVIDIA's track record shows frequent upside beats and guidance raises.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the actual forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027, announced on May 20, 2026. This is not a historical base rate but the actual communicated guidance for this specific quarter.

---

## Final Estimate

The central estimate should be NVIDIA's announced guidance of $91.0 billion. The ±2% tolerance band reflects management's confidence level. While actual results could deviate, the question asks for "forward guidance," which is the $91.0B figure they have already provided.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue was released on May 20, 2026, as part of its Q1 FY2027 earnings report. The company expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This guidance is significantly higher than the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). Notably, NVIDIA's outlook explicitly does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA also expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins to be 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are projected to be approximately $8.5 billion and $8.3 billion, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).
